title: Branch configuration head positions
statement: Let $D$, $M_1$, and $M_2$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $c$ be a configuration of the branch machine on $x$, and let $d$ and $h$ be integer head-position vectors for the tapes of $D$ and the branch machine, respectively. For either Boolean $b$, the work-head positions in the timed branch configuration formed from $c$, the supplied tapes and head positions, and the one-cell buffer containing $b$ are exactly the concatenation of $d$, $h$, and a final position $0$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite Boolean machines D, M₁, and M₂
Configuration c of the branch machine on x
Head-position vector d for D's tapes
Head-position vector h for the branch machine's tapes
